recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, warm-toned portrait of a man with a high-top fade haircut, wearing a textured knit sweater, featuring a distinct geometric logo box in the upper right corner with a mix of script and serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm golden light contrasting with deep shadows on the face
Textured knit fabric against soft-focus skin tones
Rigid geometric logo box floating in the upper right quadrant
Direct eye contact creating a central focal point
coreInvariants: High-top fade hairstyle with sharp edges
Turtleneck or mock-neck knit sweater texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and fills the lower two-thirds of the frame in a tight head-and-shoulders crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the nose serve as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the textured sweater, then jumps to the high-contrast logo box in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper left and right corners behind the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and golden-brown skin tones
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep chocolate brown shadows and dark hair
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary blue and magenta within the geometric logo
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm spectrum with low-key lighting that emphasizes depth through shadow.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens in the main portrait
Limit highlights to warm white or pale yellow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A combination of fluid, expressive script and a stable, high-contrast serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script text should have a consistent 45-degree slant with varying stroke weights
Serif text must be all-caps with thick vertical stems and thin horizontal serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'B' features an elongated tail that underlines the subsequent characters
The serif 'E' has sharp, triangular terminals

composition.relationshipToImage: anchored to the black square base

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, slanted script paired with a rigid, wide-tracked serif for a balance of energy and structure.
graphicDevices: Circular globe motif with diagonal stripes

preserve: The yellow-on-black color scheme for text
The wide tracking of the serif font
avoid: Centered text outside of the logo box

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the energetic, hand-drawn feel of the primary name.
Provides the high-contrast, elegant serif look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned, soft-focus portrait of a man with a 1980s high-top fade wearing a brown turtleneck knit sweater. Use golden hour lighting with deep shadows. Leave the top right corner clear for a graphic element.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a black square in the top right. Inside, place a circular graphic with blue and magenta shapes. Overlay a yellow script name at a slight angle and a wide-tracked yellow serif subtitle at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Does the hair have the characteristic flat-top shape?
Is the logo box placed in the upper right quadrant?
Is the subtitle font a high-contrast serif?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the geometric shapes in the logo
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Exact logo geometry to create a unique brand mark
postGenerationChecks: Check for film-like grain and soft focus edges.
Ensure the sweater texture is visible and tactile.
Verify the logo box does not obscure the subject's head.
Confirm the color palette is restricted to warm tones and primary accents.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-lit 80s male portrait with a high-top fade and a textured sweater, then anchor the composition with a high-contrast geometric logo box in the upper right containing mixed script and serif typography.
